penalties_applied.name: requires_human_fulfillment
penalties_applied.reason: Building and maintaining a validated Brazil tax integration for Salesforce CPQ/Billing (ICMS, PIS, COFINS, ISS mapping, rate tables, edge cases) requires deep, per-client implementation work — not something Claude can deliver autonomously.

penalties_applied.name: regulated_industry
penalties_applied.reason: Tax calculation is regulated; incorrect outputs create legal and financial liability for the buyer's org. Any commercial solution must meet compliance standards that a prompt-based tool cannot reliably satisfy.

rationale: The buyer is crystal-clear — a Salesforce admin or RevOps lead at a mid-market/enterprise company already paying for AvaTax, with real budget and a real pain — and Brazilian indirect tax complexity is genuinely severe. However, this is fundamentally a compliance-grade integration problem: Brazilian tax rules (ICMS with state-by-state rates, PIS/COFINS regime switching, ISS municipal codes) require either deep custom Salesforce CPQ configuration, a certified connector to a Brazilian tax engine (Synchro, Avalara BR, Sovos), or both. Claude cannot build or run this autonomously. Every customer would require a scoped implementation engagement. That makes it a consulting/implementation project, not an autonomous micro-service — wrong shape for this factory entirely.
solution_plan: This is not a viable build for this factory. The solution would need to be a certified Salesforce managed package or a professional services engagement that maps Brazilian tax rules into CPQ/Billing logic — both require compliance expertise, per-client implementation work, and ongoing rate-table maintenance that cannot be automated with Claude and a simple web page. A solo non-technical operator could not build or maintain this without a licensed tax implementation partner. If Youval has deep Salesforce CPQ and Brazil tax domain expertise, the right path would be a consulting engagement or partnership with a Salesforce ISV, not this factory.
notes: Fails build_gates: operational_autonomy=2 (well below floor of 7), buildability_with_ai=2 (below floor of 6). Regulated industry penalty and human fulfillment penalty also apply. Total after penalties is 1.7 — hard drop.
